scientific_integrity: The displayed constant follows from an exact differential-energy envelope and known compact-uniform Laguerre asymptotics. Finite numerical checks support but do not prove it. Prior-source access limits are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Laguerre parameter zero, degrees n>=1, bounded finite-variation functions. Classical Plancherel--Rotach asymptotics are used; possible unindexed priority overlap with older extremum literature and uninspected 2023 full text. No generalized-parameter result or independent validation.
title: Sharp bounded-variation Laguerre coefficient norm and its half-line localization
